verdict.rationale: Together's official TypeScript SDK states that it supports streaming responses over Server-Sent Events (SSE), so the product itself provides SSE streaming. The evidence does not show that chat/text completions are emitted token by token, so only part of the story is documented. missing for 10: first-party docs that chat/completions endpoints stream token-by-token deltas (e.g. a stream parameter and chunk format), streaming coverage in the REST API reference or Python SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency/responsiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream completions token by token over SSE for responsive user experiences

citations.quote: We provide support for streaming responses using Server Sent Events (SSE).
This library provides convenient access to the Together REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
